title: Enterprise Connectivity: customer authorization maximum
content:
## Application
Enterprise Connectivity applies this customer authorization maximum rule to invoice authorization acceptance.

## Basis: permission bound
For invoice authorization acceptance, the invoice authorization maximum equals the undiscounted transfer subtotal when campaign eligibility is eligible; otherwise add a contingency equal to that same subtotal multiplied by the Support fraction. This maximum grants permission only and does not book a charge.

## Basis Q&A
| Invoice permission bound acceptance basis | Consequence for this action |
| --- | --- |
| Invoice permission bound acceptance: The invoice authorization maximum equals the undiscounted transfer subtotal when campaign eligibility is eligible | otherwise add a contingency equal to that same subtotal multiplied by the Support fraction. This maximum grants permission only and does not book a charge. |

## Hypothetical promotion branches
With a hypothetical undiscounted subtotal of USD 80 and support fraction of 0.07, an eligible campaign leaves customer permission at USD 80. Without eligible campaign status, the contingency is USD 5.60 and permission is USD 85.60. Neither permission amount books a charge.
